prose: Dylan Saccoccio, author of the Spirit Whirled books, returns to InnerVerse to discuss his research into the links between ancient and modern languages that reveal a common source. Topics include the fraud of deep time cycles, ancient cataclysm, the astrotheology of supposed history, the Greco-Indian connection, and more.
ext: Hear more about oriental origins of occidental tongues, a debunking of the Irish Origins of Civilization, ancient Italy and the Etruscans, revealing early Roman history as myth and allegory, the secret letters of leaves, and the similarities between Welsh and Hebrew.
